title.zh: 生成函数文件上传元信息

descriptions.zh: > 获取到上传元信息后，即可把函数文件上传到OSS。更多信息，可见OSS的[服务端签名后直传](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31926.html)描述。
descriptions.en: > After you obtain the upload metadata, you can upload the function file to OSS. For more information, see [Server-side signing for direct upload](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31926.html) in the OSS documentation.
